exact_efficiency_rules.pre_pruning: After crosswalk, iteratively remove families with degree <2 traits and traits with degree <5 families before simulation; informativeness only removes edges so these systems can never enter the final core.
exact_efficiency_rules.geometry_deduplication: Systems with identical semantic class, identical ordered S3 species set, and identical prune-only species set share one known-truth simulation result exactly.
exact_efficiency_rules.axis_order: Evaluate prune-only first; if prune-only fails, skip S3 because joint PASS is already impossible.

next_if_pass: Run provenance overlap audit and graph-specific conditional-family-repeatability model-informativeness gate.
next_if_hold: Stop AusTraits replication before real memory effects.
